description: Primary source of Damage. Your opponent’s Armor value will reduce damage done.
descriptionArray: Your opponent’s Armor value will reduce damage done from your Power

earnedBy: Level Ups grant 5 automatically, or by spending Quantum Points

description: A Hero's life total. Physical & elemental damage reduces health in battle. If health drops to zero, the hero is 'Knocked Out'.
descriptionArray: Life Total of a hero or foe
Physical & elemental damage reduces health in battle, round-by-round
If health drops to zero, the hero is 'Knocked Out'
Health is recovered by 'recovery' points over time or with a health potion
Health can only be recovered if your Hero is 'Recovering' (not Knocked Out)
earnedBy: Level Ups grant 5 automatically, or by spending Quantum Points

description: Boosts Health Recovered per hour & chance to revive early from being 'Knocked Out'
descriptionArray: Chance to revive early from being 'Knocked Out' depending on how many points you have
Recovery effectiveness is subject to diminishing returns, spend QP wisely
Health pts recovered per hour = RECOVERY * (RECOVERY/(RECOVERY+55))
Chance for early revive per hour = (RECOVERY / (RECOVERY + 1055)) * 100

description: Reduces Physical Damage and is a counter to high Power adversaries.
descriptionArray: Has no effect against elemental prowess
